correctness.rationale: The state equivalence refinement of a single proposition on row-column S5 gives type (cell bit, set of bits in its row, set in its column). On the regular event, each active row/column has both bits among active rows/columns; active-active contributes distinct 0 and 1 types, and zero-row/zero-column combinations add exactly a+b+ab distinct 0 types, so K=2+a+b+ab. Successor type sets depend only on row or column inactivity, proving depth-one stabilization by induction. In critical density p=(ln n+c)/n, inactive row/column counts X,Y have joint factorial moments (n)_a(n)_b(1-p)^[n(a+b)-ab]→(e^-c)^(a+b); thus independent Poisson limits. Markov on numbers of inactive rows/columns and a binomial tail union bound for max degree < n/2 justify regularity with probability 1-o(1). Cardinality is 2^K. Fixed p∈(0,1) gives exactly four whp by a 2n[p^n+(1-p)^n] union bound. Independent modal refinement of all n=2 and n=3 regular matrices found respective K distributions n=2:{2:2}, n=3:{2:102,3:36,5:18}, agreeing with 2+a+b+ab. Finite cases do not prove Poisson convergence.

final_claim: In a random n×n two-agent S5 row/column epistemic grid with one Bernoulli atom at probability (log n+c)/n, the modal Boolean subalgebra size tends to 4,8,32 with respective probabilities e^(-2e^-c), 2e^(-e^-c)(1-e^(-e^-c)), (1-e^(-e^-c))²; all other cardinalities vanish asymptotically and modal depth one suffices with probability 1-o(1).
